data.name: About_Gen1
data.value: The first database structuring phase required to prepare the financial model is charged separately and equals one month's fee. The database covers two historical monthly years and the current monthly year.

data.name: About_Gen2
data.value: The company must provide the current year's budget in P&L format. If a projected balance sheet is available, it is included in the model; otherwise, it is projected using our methodology.

data.name: About_Gen3
data.value: The committee preparation model is not delivered, as it constitutes the service's proprietary know-how.

data.name: About_Gen4
data.value: The committee is prepared during the three days following the delivery of the month-end closing information.

data.name: About_Gen5
data.value: The committee results are published on the web in a Power BI structure.

data.name: About_Gen6
data.value: Implementation of the financial methodology requires the organization's participation, which must have an internal leader with decision-making authority.

data.name: About_Gen7
data.value: The information gathering methodology will always be available to the client in Excel format.

data.name: About_Gen8
data.value: We use Office 365 for greater security and confidentiality of information.

data.name: About_Gen9
data.value: Previously quoted fees must be paid within the first 5 days of the month.

data.name: About_Gen10
data.value: The committee implementation contract must be signed for one year.
